program:
app "Spend Light" bell slate
table spend amount money, note text?
setting limit money = 2000 "Daily spending limit"
let s = sum(spend.amount today)
row gap 2 align center
  draw 40, 120 width 70
    rect 5, 0, 30, 120 fill ink radius 8
    circle 20, 20, 11 fill if(s > limit, bad, soft)
    circle 20, 60, 11 fill if(s <= limit and s > limit * 0.8, warn, soft)
    circle 20, 100, 11 fill if(s <= limit * 0.8, good, soft)
  stack gap 1
    s big
    if(s > limit, "Over your limit", "Under your limit") "of" limit head
form spend, "Add spending"
describe:
Spend Light, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- spend: amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Daily spending limit": money, starts at 2000.
Works out:
- s is the total amount of spend today.
Shows:
- a drawing made of rectangles, circles.
- text: s.
- text: "Over your limit" when s is more than limit, otherwise "Under your limit", "of", limit.
- a form to add a spend.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first

program:
app "Plant Care" plant mint
table plant name text, every num 1..60 = 3 unit "days"
table watered plant ref plant
let thirsty = count(plant, since(it.watered) >= it.every or count(it.watered) = 0)
"Need water" thirsty big color if(thirsty > 0, warn, good)
each plant sort name as p
  row card gap 1 tap edit p
    stack grow
      p.name bold
      "every" p.every "days" faint
    if since(p.watered) >= p.every or count(p.watered) = 0
      "Thirsty" color warn
    button "Watered" tap add watered plant = p
form plant, "Add plant"
describe:
Plant Care, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- plant: name: text; every: number, 1 to 60, in days, starts at 3. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- watered: plant: a plant. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- thirsty is how many of the plant have days since the last of its watered entries is at least its every or how many its watered entries is 0.
Shows:
- text: "Need water", thirsty.
- for each plant sorted by name:
  - a group; a tap opens the plant for editing:
    - text: the name of the plant.
    - text: "every", the every of the plant, "days".
    - if days since the last of the plant's watered entries is at least the every of the plant or how many the plant's watered entries is 0:
      - text: "Thirsty".
    - a button "Watered"; a tap adds a watered with plant set to the plant.
- a form to add a plant.

program:
app "Sleep Clock" bed ink
setting bed time = 23:00 "Bedtime"
setting wake time = 7:00 "Wake-up time"
let a = 360 * (((bed - 0:00) / 1h) % 12) / 12
let b = 360 * (((wake - 0:00) / 1h) % 12) / 12
draw width 220
  circle 50, 50, 46 stroke edge thick 1
  arc 50, 50, 38, a, if(b > a, b, b + 360) stroke accent thick 6
  label 50, 8, "12" tiny
  label 92, 52, "3" tiny
  label 50, 96, "6" tiny
  label 8, 52, "9" tiny
  label 50, 50, ((wake - bed) / 1h + 24) % 24 big
"Bedtime" bed "Wake-up" wake head
describe:
Sleep Clock, in the ink colours.
You can change: "Bedtime": time of day, starts at 23:00; "Wake-up time": time of day, starts at 7:00.
Works out:
- a is 360 times the result of the result of the result of bed minus 0:00 divided by 1 hour leaves over when divided by 12 divided by 12.
- b is 360 times the result of the result of the result of wake minus 0:00 divided by 1 hour leaves over when divided by 12 divided by 12.
Shows:
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels.
- text: "Bedtime", bed, "Wake-up", wake.

app "Pool" game slate
table point team pick Dad|Son, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Dad)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Son)
setting winat num = 7 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Dad" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 1

      button "+10" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 10

  "Dad win!" head color good
if b >= winat

"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point

- text: "Son".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Son, pts set to 1.
- a button "+10"; a tap adds a point with team set to Son, pts set to 10.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.

program:
app "Eating out" food ocean
table meal_out what text, amount money, note text?
state m date = today
let spent = sum(meal_out.amount month of m)
setting budget money = 15000 "Monthly budget"
monthnav m
"Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
"Last month" sum(meal_out.amount prev month) faint
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form meal_out
list meal_out month of m by day
describe:
Eating out, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- meal out: what: text; amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 15000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of meal out in the month of m.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
- text: "Last month", the total amount of meal out last month.
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- a form to add a meal out.
- a list of meal out in the month of m by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first
order: start with the most unusual feature

program:
app "Penalties" ball ocean
table kick team pick A|B, goal bool
let ga = count(kick where team = A and goal = yes)
let gb = count(kick where team = B and goal = yes)
ga "-" gb big
row gap 1
  each 1..5 as k
    draw width 36
      circle 50, 50, 44 fill if(count(kick where team = A) < k, soft, if(last(kick.goal where team = A) = yes, good, bad))
row gap 1
  each 1..5 as k
    draw width 36
      circle 50, 50, 44 fill if(count(kick where team = B) < k, soft, if(last(kick.goal where team = B) = yes, good, bad))
row gap 1
  button "A scores" tap add kick team = A, goal = yes
  button "A misses" tap add kick team = A, goal = no
row gap 1
  button "B scores" tap add kick team = B, goal = yes
  button "B misses" tap add kick team = B, goal = no
button "New shootout" tap remove all kick
describe:
Penalties, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- kick: team: one of A, B; goal: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- ga is how many kick entries where team is A and goal is yes.
- gb is how many kick entries where team is B and goal is yes.
Shows:
- text: ga, "-", gb.
- for each number from 1 to 5:
  - a drawing made of circles.
- for each number from 1 to 5:
  - a drawing made of circles.
- a button "A scores"; a tap adds a kick with team set to A, goal set to yes.
- a button "A misses"; a tap adds a kick with team set to A, goal set to no.
- a button "B scores"; a tap adds a kick with team set to B, goal set to yes.
- a button "B misses"; a tap adds a kick with team set to B, goal set to no.
- a button "New shootout"; a tap removes all kick entries, with one undo.
hurried_style: lowercase with one or two typos, 3 to 10 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: mention the screen layout first if there is one
